---
title: Spaghetti with Squid Ink
id: MAR-0109
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 65
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g spaghetti
- 400 g squid, ready to cook, and their ink sacs
- 350 g tomato
- 1 onion
- 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Blanch the tomatoes in salted water, drain them, peel them, remove the seeds, and chop them.
2. Peel the onion and dice it.
3. Cut the squid into thin strips.
4. Heat the oil in a pan, add the onion and cook over low heat for 5 minutes.
5. Add the squid and after 5 minutes the tomatoes.
6. Salt, cover, and cook for 45 minutes, removing the lid only at the end of cooking; 5 minutes before turning off the heat, add the ink sacs.
7. Cook the spaghetti in boiling salted water, drain them, add them to the pan with the squid, mix, and serve.
